profile_text.body:
Snap Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Monica, California, trading under the ticker SNAP and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001564408. On its own site the company describes itself around the camera, saying it believes the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. It says it contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The site text does not name specific products or services, and no products are tracked for the company in the record. No individual lawsuits are listed, and no MCP servers are associated with it. Its legal exposure is recorded as concentrated in California, with 281 matters counted there.
